question: Describe a time you had to present technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-B with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-B professionals.
exampleAnswer: I analysed customer churn data and presented to the sales team. I avoided jargon, used visual charts, and focused on business impact. I explained that 12% churn was tied to onboarding issues. The team adopted my recommendations, reducing churn by 8% in 6 months.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, communication, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-B role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
